description: Neighborhood feature with a reaction beat. Establish the area with a local exterior, demonstrate the app feature, land an optional reaction, pay off with another local shot, close. B-roll slots scope to the brief's neighborhood; the app slot to the brief's feature; the reaction to the brief's mood (skipped if none matches). Set Neighborhood, Feature, and Mood on the brief.

slots.notes: Establish the neighborhood. Exterior preferred so it opens on place.
The feature moment. match_feature scopes it to the brief's feature (subtype). No neighborhood match: app clips are not geographic.

Optional. Reactions carry no city or neighborhood, so city_agnostic_ok is set. match_mood restricts it to the brief's mood from merged emotion tags. Skipped and the video built without it if nothing matches.
Another shot in the neighborhood — the local payoff.
Background for the call-to-action text, or the branded end-card when with_endcard is on.

captions.notes: Opens on the neighborhood name. Dropped if the clip has no neighborhood.

captions.pattern: Find it in Big City Travel Guide
captions.notes: Fixed copy. Suppressed automatically when the branded end-card fills this slot.
